faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Project Associate 1 - Product Design recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Associate 1 - Product Design position at IIT Guwahati is 27th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification required for the Project Associate 1 - Product Design role is a Master of Design (M.Des) degree in Product Design or any equivalent allied field.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate 1 - Product Design post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Associate 1 - Product Design position in the latest recruitment drive by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate 1 position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Associate 1 - Product Design post will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 31,000 to Rs. 36,580, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Associate 1 - Product Design role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will primarily involve an online interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and then invited for the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is contractual in nature. This means the position is for a fixed term, as specified in the appointment order.

faq.question: Q9. Will shortlisted candidates be informed? How?
faq.answer: Yes, shortlisted candidates will be informed via email. This communication will likely contain details about the next steps, including the interview schedule.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this position?
faq.answer: No, applications for the IIT Guwahati Project Associate 1 - Product Design recruitment must be submitted online only. Offline applications will not be accepted.
